maria (sre): Quick broadcast: follow-up to last night's routing fallbacks — short recap and policy + ops changes.
sre-bot: Alert: routing-proxy-eu-west high queue depth 2026-03-24T04:12Z -> auto-fallback to quant-v1.
maria (sre): Summary: kubelet restarts + router scale-in caused admission spikes; fallback lasted ~22m, p99 +180ms, no data loss.
tony (sre): Root cause: simultaneous node reboots and control-plane rate limiter interacting with long-lived connections.
kai (runtime): Mitigations rolled: reduce scale-in aggressiveness, shorten kv-cache TTL during pressure, tune soft-preempt backoff (rolled 04:20-04:32).
sam (prod): Some EU customers saw minor quality shifts after fallback; support got ~8 tickets about punctuation/tokenization differences.
maria (sre): Policy update (effective immediately): Controlled fallback = automated infra-triggered model switch that preserves completeness. Do not page SRE for controlled fallback if user-visible error-rate <1% and duration <15m. If duration >15m schedule postmortem + 72h corrective ticket. Product must be notified within 30m for any fallback that changes model family/quantization. Dedicated customers: auto-fallbacks disabled by default.
tony (sre): Ops actions: add per-AZ inflight CB limiting to 5k, increase router ASG scale-in cooldown 45s->120s, add weekly synthetic for node-reboot+soft-preempt. Owners: tony/kai/eli.
support-oncall: Do we auto-send customer template?
sam (prod): We'll produce a pre-approved 30m notification template; support can send once product signs off.
sre-bot: Scheduled: circuit-breaker canary 2026-03-26T01:00Z.
maria (sre): I'll add the policy to the Reliability Playbook and post link here when merged. Closing thread.
